bio.text: Rev. Clyde W. Jones Jr. is the Democratic candidate for Alabama's 1st Congressional District in 2026.

According to his campaign website, he is a native of Charles City, Virginia, who served 21 years in the U.S. Army, retiring as a First Sergeant in the Signal Corps, and received the Bronze Star Medal for service in Operation Desert Storm and Operation Iraqi Freedom II.
He moved to South Alabama in 2013 to work with DuPont, retired from FMC Corporation in May 2024, and holds a B.S. in liberal arts from Excelsior University.
He is an associate minister at Macedonia Missionary Baptist Church and a former president of the board of Alabama Arise.

sources.title: Clyde Jones for Alabama's First Congressional District
